blocks.text: PARIS, France — French regional bank Credit Mutuel Arkea said Wednesday it had been the victim of a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent transactions amounting to around 100 million euros ($112 million). The bank said the attack, which had been “contained,” allowed hackers to gain access to Arkea’s accounts and transfer funds to other banks, but not to clients’ accounts. Clients did not suffer any losses. Arkea added that the stolen funds were converted into cryptocurrencies on specialized platforms, but said a portion had been blocked and other efforts were underway to recover the money.
